toolDescriptions.workflow_list_templates: List existing task templates (id / name / node count)
toolDescriptions.workflow_get_template: Read a template's full structure (nodes / edges / run inputs) by id
toolDescriptions.workflow_create_template: Create an empty template and return templateId, then add nodes and edges step by step
toolDescriptions.workflow_update_template: Update a template's name, description, or run inputs (only provided fields)
toolDescriptions.workflow_add_node: Add a node: input / agent / review / condition / loop / parallel / manual / tool / end
toolDescriptions.workflow_add_edge: Connect two nodes; label pass / fail branches to build an iteration loop
toolDescriptions.workflow_update_edge: Update an edge's when label (pass / fail / clear)
toolDescriptions.workflow_delete_edge: Delete an edge (repair extra edges or cycles)
toolDescriptions.workflow_update_node: Update a node's label, instruction, role, or loop rounds
toolDescriptions.workflow_delete_node: Delete a node and clean up its connected edges
toolDescriptions.workflow_validate_template: Validate flow structure: missing role/instruction, bad branches, cycles, multiple entries, invalid employee ids
toolDescriptions.workflow_delete_template: Permanently delete a template (irreversible, requires confirmation)

page.title: Task Templates
page.desc: Turn complex tasks into visual workflows and let digital employees execute them step by step.
page.empty: No templates yet. Click "New template" to build your first workflow.

template.name: Template name
template.descriptionPlaceholder: What problem does this template solve, what inputs are needed
template.variablesHint: Values to fill in when running; reference them in node instructions as {{name}}
template.variableDescPlaceholder: Hint shown to the person filling in the run form

canvas.selectNode: Select a node on the canvas to edit its properties
canvas.dropHint: Click a node in the left library to add it

node.agentDesc: Run one step with a digital employee or ephemeral role
node.reviewDesc: Structured review producing a pass/fail verdict
node.conditionDesc: Route branches by upstream verdict or expression
node.loopDesc: Bound iteration rounds, exit when exceeded
node.parallelDesc: Run branches in parallel and aggregate
node.humanDesc: Pause and wait for manual confirmation

field.label: Node name
field.roleSourceHint: Digital employee: reuse an existing employee's persona and tools; Ephemeral role: template-only, needs a name and prompt
field.employeeEmpty: No digital employees yet. Switch to "Ephemeral role", or create one on the Employees page
field.ephemeralPromptPlaceholder: Describe this role's duty, output requirements and working style
field.ephemeralToolsHint: Leave empty to use the default toolset; only pick tools this role additionally needs
field.instructionPlaceholder: Describe what this step does. Use {{var}} or {{nodeId}} to reference upstream output
field.instructionHint: Variables: {{var}} for run inputs, {{nodeId}} for upstream node output
field.maxRoundsHint: After reaching the limit the loop stops re-entering
field.verdictHint: Review verdict comes from the LLM's FINAL_VERDICT marker (PASS / FAIL) and drives outgoing branches

edge.labelHint: Matched against the verdict: pass branch on pass, fail branch on fail; default branch as fallback
edge.normalHint: Normal nodes run in order and only follow the default branch
edge.labeledWarning: This node is not a review/condition node, the branch label never matches and the flow stops here
